description: This file contains implementations of comparison and analysis functions for the ocuduvec library, including SIMD-optimized functions for finding maximum elements and counting elements exceeding a threshold, as well as a string search function.

methods.name: ocudu::ocuduvec::detail::find
methods.description: Searches for a character value within a span of characters using SIMD acceleration when available.

methods.name: ocudu::ocuduvec::max_abs_element
methods.description: Finds the index and squared magnitude of the maximum absolute value element in a span of complex floats.

methods.name: ocudu::ocuduvec::max_element
methods.description: Finds the index and value of the maximum element in a span of floats.

methods.name: ocudu::ocuduvec::count_if_part_abs_greater_than
methods.description: Counts the number of complex float samples in a span where either the real or imaginary part exceeds a threshold.
